name: Timely Time Tracking
description: Timely is automatic time-tracking and timesheet software for consultancies, agencies, software businesses, and other project-based teams. Organizations use it to capture work, plan time, organize projects and clients, coordinate people and capacity, monitor billable work and budgets, produce reports, and prepare invoices.
agentUseSummary: Connect Timely once, then choose which agents can read or manage the connected workspaces' time, projects, clients, people, teams, tasks, reports, and settings under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read time and workspace data
capabilities.description: Use all 32 pinned official reads for accounts, time, projects, clients, people, teams, tasks, reports, capacities, permissions, tags, states, and webhooks.

capabilities.label: Manage time and workspaces
capabilities.description: Use all 38 pinned official mutations for time, timers, projects, clients, people, teams, tasks, tags, states, permissions, and webhooks.

allowed.label: Read Timely
allowed.description: Run one exact selected Timely GET operation from the pinned official API contract.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Timely
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact selected Timely mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 32 bounded reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 70 selected and provider-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; ownership, OAuth authority, exact routes, bounds, audits, redaction, provider limits, and Timely permissions still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts all 70 pinned Timely application operations through the authenticated server-side connector.
Railway mounts all 70 pinned Timely application operations through the authenticated server-side connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's Timely OAuth application, exact production callback, Railway client credentials, and a representative connected workspace are not configured.
providerSetup.nextAction: Use an administrator account to create Relay Console as a confidential OAuth application inside Timely, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/timely-time-tracking/callback exactly, store TIMELY_TIME_TRACKING_CLIENT_ID and TIMELY_TIME_TRACKING_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, deploy, then verify authorization, manage-scope grant, account and user binding, refresh, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutations, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Timely publishes an embedded OpenAPI 3.1.0 document with SHA-256 7a6b42701035a887f513ec2ca9eafe61942eec229e705101a3e025a9df27dcab. Relay pins 70 application operations: 32 reads and 38 mutations; OAuth token-management endpoints remain broker-only rather than agent tools.

Timely documents confidential OAuth 2.0 authorization code applications, the manage scope, bearer tokens, access and refresh tokens, token introspection, token revocation, account discovery, and application creation by a Timely workspace administrator.

Timely describes automatic time tracking, timesheets, project and people planning, capacity, reports, invoices, billable time, budgets, and project profitability for consultancies, agencies, and software businesses.
Timely presents integrations as connected workflows around its automatic time tracking product; Relay uses Timely's own documented OAuth application API instead of asking users for an API key.
